newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CMB may lose franchise after expiration.
newsitem.headline: CMB may lose franchise after expiration.

text.p: China Motor Bus Co Ltd may lose its bus routes after its franchise expires next year, the Hong Kong government said on Friday.

"The Transport Department is considering a number of proposals including perhaps whether China Motor Bus should be granted a new franchise or whether its routes should be tendered out," Issac Chow, deputy transport secretary, told reporters.
China Motor Bus (CMB) operates franchised public buses on Hong Kong island, along with Citybus Group Ltd.

Government radio reported CMB had missed the deadline to apply for an extension of its franchise, which will expire in August 1998. Under present rules, the bus company has to apply for the extension 15 months before the expiration.
